author: Claude (mood-goals task), written before the mood goals were added
status: Provisional model-authored judgments; not expert ground truth. Written before any cue was chosen; cues were not tuned to these texts afterwards.
note: Energetic briefs (m03, m04) expect suggest-motion, which already covers energy (decided from the taxonomy, not from results). m13 added with the wistful goal before its cues were run.
policy: goals lists the mood goal the brief asks the picture to carry. Other goals the brief may also want are not penalised by this set.

cases.text: Poster for a community choir concert in a church, warm and communal.
Flyer for the village harvest supper: everyone round one long table, the kind of evening that makes you feel at home.
Launch campaign for a new boxing gym. It has to be punchy and high-octane, all adrenaline.
Opening slide for a festival of street dance, loud, lively and buzzing with life.
Cover for our annual report to shareholders. Serious, authoritative, nothing frivolous.
Header image for a law firm's page on compliance, it should feel trustworthy and dependable.
Playful flyer for the school's kids' book fair, silly and fun.
Social post for an ice-cream van's summer tour, cheeky and whimsical, make people grin.
Magazine ad for a luxurious new perfume, elegant and refined.
Hero image for a five-star hotel's spring offer; it should feel exclusive, opulent, high-end.
Calm image for a wellness slide about breathing exercises.
Background for a mindfulness app's sleep screen, soft and soothing, slowing everything down.
Cover for a memoir about leaving home, quiet and bittersweet, the empty platform after the train has gone.
